transition_policy.pressure_update: May advance continuously from documented local events and recovery efforts.
transition_policy.phase_transition: Requires observed evidence, compatibility review, impact record and authorial gate.
transition_policy.offline_policy: Offline simulation may accumulate bounded pressure but cannot change phase, reveal sealed facts or destroy irreplaceable canon.

simulation_effects: The global clock exposes proportional local signs without naming sealed cosmic facts.
Containment, restoration and investigation can slow or redirect pressure locally but cannot erase the causal record.
Espinho-Negro reactions can locate or contest corruption only within symbiosis, material and revelation limits.
story_generators: A city discovers that its cheap water route is feeding an unseen phase of the Root.
A local success slows the planetary clock but transfers danger to a rival territory.
An outbreak offers proof of Votakhel's design while forcing characters to preserve a sealed truth.
